description: Provider calendar, service management, and admin oversight. Everything the people running BookIt need.

issues.title: Provider calendar: view booked appointments
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §6 /provider/calendar. Providers need to see what's booked.

## Task
Build `/provider/calendar` showing the signed-in provider's upcoming appointments (day/week view), backed by an appointments-by-provider query.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Shows only the signed-in provider's appointments (server-side ownership check).
- [ ] Displays customer name, service, start/end time.
- [ ] Empty state when nothing is booked.
- [ ] Unit test for the by-provider query + ownership.

issues.title: Service management: edit + deactivate services
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §6 /provider/services, Service.active.

## Task
Extend `/provider/services` with edit and deactivate. Deactivated services stop appearing in the public catalog but keep their history.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Provider can edit name, description, category, durationMin of their own service.
- [ ] Deactivating sets active=false; it disappears from GET /api/services.
- [ ] Only the owning provider can edit/deactivate (403 otherwise).
- [ ] Tests cover ownership + the active filter.

issues.title: Admin dashboard: users, services, bookings overview
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §2 admin role, §6 /admin.

## Task
Build `/admin` with read-only lists of users, services, and appointments, plus basic search/filter.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Route is ADMIN-only (403 for customer/provider), enforced server-side.
- [ ] Lists paginate and do not leak passwordHash or session tokens.
- [ ] No PII in logs.
- [ ] Tests cover the admin-only authorization.

issues.title: Admin action: deactivate a user
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §2 (admin can manage users).

## Task
Allow an admin to deactivate a user. A deactivated user cannot log in; their future appointments are cancelled and slots freed.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] ADMIN-only endpoint (403 otherwise).
- [ ] Deactivated user's login is rejected.
- [ ] Their future CONFIRMED appointments become CANCELLED and slots free up.
- [ ] Tests cover authorization + the cascade.
